description: This file implements a transcription-based user turn stop strategy class that manages user speech detection and transcription handling to determine when a user has stopped speaking, using asyncio for asynchronous operations.

classes.name: TranscriptionUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that stops user turn detection based on transcription activity and VAD frames, managing internal state and asynchronous tasks.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the strategy with optional timeout and other keyword arguments.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the strategy to initial conditions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up the strategy with a provided task manager, creating an internal task.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up the strategy, cancelling the internal task if it exists.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes an incoming frame to update internal state based on frame type.

methods.name: _handle_vad_user_started_speaking
methods.description: Handles VAD frame indicating user started speaking.

methods.name: _handle_vad_user_stopped_speaking
methods.description: Handles VAD frame indicating user stopped speaking and may trigger turn stop.

methods.name: _handle_interim_transcription
methods.description: Handles interim transcription frames, updating interim results state.

methods.name: _handle_transcription
methods.description: Handles final transcription frames, appending text and resetting interim results.

methods.name: _task_handler
methods.description: Asynchronous loop monitoring transcription activity to trigger user turn stop when appropriate.

methods.name: _maybe_trigger_user_turn_stopped
methods.description: Checks conditions and triggers user turn stopped event if criteria are met.
